questions: Do you tend to fall backwards without warning?
When you walk, do your feet feel "stuck" to the floor?
Do you have difficulty looking up or down on command?
Have you developed any stiffness in your arms or legs?
Have your eyelids felt heavy or closed tightly (blepharospasm)?
Have you noticed slowness in your thinking or personality changes?
Are you over the age of 60?
